findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: privi_url_safety · Private data: privi_nonce_generate, privi_secret_scan, privi_log_redact, privi_url_safety, privi_dedupe_records, privi_token_cost, privi_idempotency_key, privi_pro_auth_session_review, privi_pro_dataset_quality, privi_pro_data_freshness, privi_pro_model_cost_estimate · Public sink: privi_log_redact, privi_pro_pii_presence · Destructive: privi_log_redact, privi_pro_run_health_summary.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: privi_url_safety · Private data: privi_nonce_generate, privi_secret_scan, privi_log_redact, privi_url_safety, privi_dedupe_records, privi_token_cost, privi_idempotency_key, privi_pro_auth_session_review, privi_pro_dataset_quality, privi_pro_data_freshness, privi_pro_model_cost_estimate · Public sink: privi_log_redact, privi_pro_pii_presence · Destructive: privi_log_redact, privi_pro_run_health_summary

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
